text:
Rae (Design): dropping a new variant of the version-history scrubber. main changes: compact preview card on hover, inline experiment tag (A/B label), and tooltip that shows traffic delta. want quick a11y + copy sanity check before dev. screenshots in figma link.
Omar (Eng): nice. question: hover preview is neat, but on keyboard we should show on focus. do we keep hover and focus consistent?
Rae (Design): yes same preview on hover or focus. for keyboard the preview will appear after 200ms to avoid accidental pop.
Sam (A11y): 200ms delay ok but ensure it is reachable via keyboard without additional keypress. add `aria-describedby` from snapshot button to the preview content id so SRs can read it. avoid using purely color cues for A/B label.
Nina (Product): copy ideas: A/B tag show variant id & percent, e.g., 'Variant B · 23% traffic'. tooltip line: 'Expected latency change: +12 ms'. happy to include short note about data freshness.
Rae (Design): current tooltip drafts: line1: 'Variant B — 23%'; line2: 'Latency +12 ms'; line3 (muted): 'Data window: last 15m'. open to shorten.
Sam (A11y): prefer 'Variant B — 23% traffic' to be explicit. SR reading order: button label -> preview heading -> short summary. use `role=tooltip` and ensure it's dismissible when focus moves. also avoid `aria-live` for every hover open to prevent noise.
Omar (Eng): perf note: previews request `/api/timeline/preview?snapshot_id=...`. we should debounce requests for rapid scrubbing and cache last 5 previews to keep latency low. also telemetry: emit `ui.scrubber.preview` with {snapshot_id, triggered_by: 'hover'|'focus'}.
Nina (Product): decision on copy: keep two-line tooltip. shorten to: 'Variant B · 23% traffic' and 'Latency +12 ms (15m)'. adds clarity.
Rae (Design): visual contrast question: the A/B pill uses pale yellow on white — low contrast. suggestions?
Sam (A11y): use a darker background or border. recommend dark text on light amber (#d97706) or white text on amber with sufficient contrast. add `aria-hidden` icon but include text for SR.
Omar (Eng): keyboard scrub behavior: left/right arrows move snapshot focus; holding arrow should accelerate. when preview opens on focus, pressing Space should open snapshot details. is that expected?
Rae (Design): yes Space opens details; Enter triggers selection (e.g., jump to snapshot). will add small helper hint: 'Enter to open, Space for details' shown in status area.
Sam (A11y): ensure those hints are visually subtle but available to SR via `aria-describedby`. for touch users, long-press opens preview. avoid duplicating actions that conflict with native OS gestures.
deploy-bot: timeline-service: A/B check   no anomalies in last 1h.
Nina (Product): action: Rae to update figma with SR text and shorter tooltip. Omar to add debounce/caching. Sam to provide exact aria-describedby snippets. ETA by EOD Friday.
Rae (Design): will do and add small mock for reduced-motion users (no animated scrub preview). thanks folks :raised_hands:
